responsibility: This is the top-level NDS32 machine description file that assembles the backend’s RTL instruction set model. It includes the shared predicate/constraint/iterator/pipeline subfiles and the specialized intrinsic, multiple-memory, doubleword, FPU, DSP, and peephole descriptions, while also defining global instruction attributes and the baseline scalar, control-flow, TLS/PIC, exception, and other core patterns that form the main recognizer and expander body for the target.
same_name_distinction: Within the nds32 same-name set, this is the main RTL machine-description file: it declares instruction attributes and core define_insn/define_expand patterns, and includes specialized md subfiles such as nds32-intrinsic.md, rather than providing C++ hook code, preprocessor configuration macros, or command-line option declarations.
